## About
29th Street Auto is a family operated small business in Phoenix. We offer honest, reliable auto repair, and we like to think we do it right. We want the process of fixing your car to be as easy as we can make it.
Our ASE Master certified techs use current diagnostic technology to find the problem and get you back on the road. Whether you drive an import or a domestic, bring it in for scheduled maintenance, extended warranty work, bigger repairs or a simple oil change.
We hold a 4.4 rating from 26 reviews on Google. If you don't see the repair you need on our list, give us a call and ask.

## Services
- Brake repair: Brake work is one of the things we focus on.
- Diagnostics: We use current diagnostic technology to find what's wrong and turn the job around quickly.
- Tire repair, balance and rotation: Bring your tires to us for repairs, balancing and rotation.
- Air conditioning repair and maintenance: Keep your car's air conditioning working through the Phoenix heat.
- Radiators and coolant systems: Radiator and cooling system repair to keep your engine from running hot.
- Scheduled maintenance and warranty work: Scheduled maintenance, extended warranty work, technical repairs or a simple oil change for imports and domestics.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. Whether you own an import or a domestic, you can bring it to us.

Q: Do you handle extended warranty work?
A: Yes. Along with scheduled maintenance and repairs, we do extended warranty work.

Q: What if the repair I need isn't on your list?
A: Our list shows the common repairs we do, not everything. Call us and ask.
